description: Roundtable id = RFC 4648 base32 (standard alphabet, lowercased, no padding) of SHA-256("NereusSDR roundtable id v1\n" || SPKI DER), first 26 characters (Roundtable document section 4.1). digestHex is the SHA-256. rendezvousId is the same key's rendezvous id (rendezvous document section 4.2), given to show the two services never share an id for one key.

cases.name: a
cases.fixed: A fixed test key for these vectors only. It was generated to produce them and is used by nothing else: no Core, station, server or website key holds it. The private scalar is recorded so a runner can sign with it in its own tests; it protects nothing.
